(c) Reload preserves activeTab='ia' from localStorage. (d) Search 'Universal' inside IA tab matches 1 parameter (not all). (e) 'Tous' tab restores full visibility (Universal Key + reCAPTCHA + SMTP all visible together). P3 verified: (a) /admin/brochures mounts [data-testid=admin-brochures-page] with [data-testid=admin-media-library] (title 'Bibliothèque médias') ABOVE BrochuresWidget. (b) Upload via [data-testid=admin-media-library] hidden file input with prompt-accepted title creates a card in [data-testid=media-library-grid] (cards=1 after upload). (d) Image card carries [data-testid=social-share-image], opens menu with all 8 platforms (whatsapp, facebook, twitter, linkedin, telegram, email, youtube, tiktok) + [data-testid=social-share-copy]. (e) PDF cards correctly have NO social-share descendant (hasShareAny=false on all 4 static cards). Existing PdfViewer flow remains intact (no regression — same data-testid scheme as iter44).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (PortalLayout.jsx:407 + AdminSettings.jsx jump-select uses inline <span style='display:contents'> to wrap the 🆕 badge inside <option>). Carry-over from iter43/iter44 — not a regression, cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic, recurring since iter43): silence the React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' by writing the 🆕 prefix as a flat string inside the <option> instead of wrapping it in a <span style='display:contents'>. Affects PortalLayout.jsx:407 and AdminSettings.jsx jump-select rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: AdminSettings.jsx — Filterable returns null entirely (line 159: `if (ctx?.activeTab && ctx.activeTab !== 'all' && cat !== ctx.activeTab) return null;`) so off-tab sections are not just hidden but removed from DOM. Verified via DOM count = 5 sections under IA tab.

Good: SettingsToolbar derives both `visibleTitles` for the jump-select AND `countsPerTab` from the same registry; counts are computed before the early `if (!ctx) return null` so React hook order stays stable across renders (line 187-194 comment is accurate).
Good: localStorage key 'adminSettings.activeTab' is read inside useState initializer with try/catch fallback to 'all' — safe for SSR/incognito (line 315).

Good: backend routes/media_library.py validates MIME against ALLOWED_MIME, caps size per kind (PDF 50 MB / video 200 MB / image 15 MB), uses soft-delete (is_deleted=True), strips _id on response, and re-delete returns 404. Auth gate `_gate(user)` covers admin + superviseur + tracked Administrateur/Superviseur.
Good: PortalBrochures.jsx merges static legacy PDFs + media library items into a single grid; only IMAGE/VIDEO cards render <SocialShareButtons> (PDF cards correctly omit it, matching spec).

Good: SocialShareButtons.jsx exposes [data-testid=social-share-${kind}] root + [data-testid=social-share-trigger] + [data-testid=social-share-menu] + per-platform [data-testid=social-share-${key}] + [data-testid=social-share-copy] — fully testable.

Minor: the AdminMediaLibrary upload UX uses window.prompt() for the title (blocking, no validation feedback). Works correctly but a small modal with a text input + 'public' toggle would be more polished. Non-blocking.
Minor pre-existing (carry from iter43/44): <span style='display:contents'> wrapper inside <option> triggers the recurring React hydration warning. Cosmetic.
